q1.title: What capability is #688 changing?
q1.imperative: State the capability in present tense, from behaviour not mechanism.
q1.finding: fact: capability = graded (not binary) session-wetness -> grip-offset sigma.

q2.title: Does the grip fit actually EXCLUDE rain-affected sessions, as the issue body states?
q2.imperative: Read the fit path end to end and establish what rain actually does.
q2.finding: fact: NO exclusion exists; rain multiplies session_offset_sigma by 4.0. Issue body wrong.

q3.title: Is rain_flag_from_raw (the symbol the issue names) still the live rain source?
q3.imperative: Reconcile the issue's named symbol against main, not against this worktree's HEAD.
q3.finding: fact: rain_flag_from_raw is LEGACY as of #680 (main d4cd4b79, NOT in this checkout).

q4.title: Did the #680 source swap already fix the 'any wet sample' defect?
q4.imperative: Read the new canonical source's own derivation.
q4.finding: fact: defect survived the swap; session_rain_flag is still any-wet-sample.

q5.title: Is the continuous wetness signal available on the session types the coverage crux is about?
q5.imperative: Measure it against the real season DBs, do not infer it from the docstring.
q5.finding: fact: wet_lap_fraction is R-only; measured 0/22 populated for Q in 2022 and 2023.

q6.title: Is there an in-repo precedent for a graded wetness read with a non-R fallback?
q6.imperative: Search the physics region for existing wetness graders before designing one.

q7.imperative: Find the code that performs the drop; if none, say so.
q7.finding: fact: no committed consumer drops on rain; the weekend rule was spike-only.

q8.title: Which lever actually recovers coverage: threshold loosening, or session-grain treatment?
q8.imperative: Measure both on the real substrate before choosing a mechanism.
q8.finding: fact: granularity +25pts of session retention vs threshold +1-2pts (2022+23, 220 sessions).

q9.title: Does #688 change the CONSUMER's gating, or only the producer's signal?
q9.imperative: This is the counterpart's scope call; take it from the frozen governing artifact.
q9.finding: decision: producer-side only; consumer contract is #712 (owner, stream terminal).

q10.title: Does #688 land standalone, or behind the rest of the W2 chain?
q10.imperative: Sequencing against #679/#678/#687 is the counterpart's call.
q10.finding: decision: lands behind #679/#678/#687 as W2 step 6; additive to the re-keyed record.

q11.title: May the graded treatment make a rain-flagged session's sigma NARROWER than today?
q11.imperative: This cuts against the module's FROZEN 'rain must widen' requirement; the counterpart must authorize it.
q11.finding: decision: narrower allowed for marginal wet, 4.0 preserved at full wetness.
